about: Prompts of the illustrated lesson library: two original characters (Lan and Minh), drawn once on a local GPU (motion-studio images-library) and reused by every lesson. Style D (chibi anime figures) is the main look; style A (clean anime) is mixed in, about 1 shot in 4. No studio, film, game, brand, channel or real person is named; both characters are adults in ordinary clothes.
